```spice
Wien-Bridge Oscillator
* Components
R1 2 3 10k
C1 1 2 16n
R2 1 0 10k
C2 1 0 16n
Rf 3 4 21k
Rg 4 0 10k

* Op-Amp instantiation
X1 1 4 3 opamp

* Op-Amp Subcircuit
.subckt opamp inp inn out
Rin inp inn 1e7
B1 out 0 V = 14*tanh(1e5*(v(inp)-v(inn))/14)
.ends

* Analysis: Transient analysis for 1kHz oscillation (T=1ms)
.tran 0 5m 0 10u

.end
```

Confidence: high

* The circuit is a standard Wien-Bridge oscillator; the output node (3) is fed back to the non-inverting input via the RC network and to the inverting input via the voltage divider (Rf, Rg).
* The output node is labeled "OUT" in the drawing, mapped to node 3 in the netlist.
